questions.stem:
Circle \(C_1\) has equation \(x^2+y^2=16\). \(O\) is the origin and \(A=(6,0)\). \(P\) is a moving point on \(C_1\), and \(M\) is the midpoint of \(AP\).
(a) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma\) of \(M\).
(b) \(C_1\) and \(\Gamma\) intersect at points \(X\) and \(Y\). Find \(XY\).
(c) Someone claims that \(\angle XAY>30°\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.hint: Midpoint transform. Subtract circle equations for radical axis.
questions.hintZh: 中點變換。減圓方程找根軸。
questions.solution:
(a) \(P=(2x-6,2y)\), so \(\Gamma:(x-3)^2+y^2=4\).
(b) Subtract the circle equations to obtain \(x=7/2\). Then \(y=\pm\sqrt{15}/2\), so \(XY=\sqrt{15}\).
(c) \(\angle XAY=2\arctan(\sqrt{15}/5)\approx75.52^\circ>30^\circ\). Agree.

questions.stem:
The coordinates of \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) are \((0,0)\), \((6,0)\) and \((9,0)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point such that \(\angle APB=90°\). \(Q\) is the midpoint of \(PC\).
(a) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma_1\) of \(P\).
(b) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma_2\) of \(Q\).
(c) Find the coordinates of the point on \(\Gamma_2\) nearest to \(A\).
questions.hint: Coordinate transform. Excluded endpoints.
questions.hintZh: 坐標變換。排除端點。
questions.solution:
(a) \((u-3)^2+v^2=9\), excluding \(A,B\).
(b) \(u=2x-9,v=2y\), hence \((x-6)^2+y^2=9/4\), excluding \((9/2,0),(15/2,0)\).
(c) No nearest point exists on the actual locus: the closest point of the full circle, \((9/2,0)\), is excluded. The distance approaches \(9/2\) but never attains it. If the intended question means the full supporting circle, its nearest point is \((9/2,0)\).

questions.stem:
13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,6)\) and \((8,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A P=2 B P\).
(a) Prove that the locus is a circle.
(b) Let the centre of the locus be \(C\). Someone claims that the ratio of the area of \(\triangle Q A B\) to the area of \(\triangle Q B C\) is \(3: 1\), where \(Q(-6,0)\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((0,6)\) 和 \((8,0)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=2BP\)。
(a) 證明 \(P\) 的軌跡為一個圓。
(b) 設該軌跡的圓心為 \(C\)。有人聲稱，當 \(Q=(-6,0)\) 時，\(\triangle QAB\) 與 \(\triangle QBC\) 的面積比為 \(3:1\)。你是否同意？解釋答案。
questions.hint: Apollonius circle: square ratio. Collinearity check slopes.
questions.hintZh: 阿氏圓：平方比例。斜率檢查共線。
questions.solution:
13. (a) Let \(P=(x, y)\)
\(\sqrt{x^{2}+(y-6)^{2}}=2 \sqrt{(x-8)^{2}+y^{2}}\)

\(3 x^{2}+3 y^{2}-64 x+12 y+220=0\)
\(x^{2}+y^{2}-\frac{64}{3} x+4 y+\frac{220}{3}=0\)

\(\left(x-\frac{32}{3}\right)^{2}+(y+2)^{2}=\left(\frac{20}{3}\right)^{2}\)
∴ The locus is a circle with centre \(\left(\frac{32}{3},-2\right)\) and radius \(\frac{20}{3}\)
(b) \(\frac{\text { Area of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { Area of } \triangle Q B C}=\frac{\text { altitude of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { altitude of } \triangle Q B C}\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{6}{2} \\
& =\frac{3}{1}
\end{aligned}
\]

slope of \(A B=\frac{6-0}{0-8}=-\frac{3}{4}\)
Slope of \(B C=\frac{-2-6}{\frac{32}{3}-0}=-\frac{3}{4}\)
\(\therefore A, B\) and \(C\) are collinear.
\(\frac{\text { Area of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { Area of } \triangle Q B C}=\frac{A B}{B C}\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{8-0}{\frac{32}{3}-8} / \frac{6-0}{0+2} / \frac{\sqrt{(0-8)^{2}+(6-0)^{2}}}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{32}{3}-8\right)^{2}+(-2-0)^{2}}} \\
& =\frac{3}{1}
\end{aligned}
\]

Hence, the claim is correct. I agree.

questions.stem:
14. The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-6,0)\) and \((12,24)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point on the coordinate plane such that \(AP=BP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(G\).
(a)
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(G\) and \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(G\).
(b) \(G\) cuts the \(x\)-axis at \(C\). A straight line parallel to \(AB\) cuts the \(x\)-axis and \(G\) at \(D\) and \(E\) respectively. It is given that \(E\) is above the \(x\)-axis. If the area of \(\triangle CDE\) is \(24\), find the area of the circle passing through \(C\), \(D\) and \(E\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A=(-6,0)\)、\(B=(12,24)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=BP\)，軌跡記為 \(G\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(G\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(G\) 方程。
(b) \(G\) 與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(C\)。一條平行於 \(AB\) 的直線分別與 \(x\) 軸、\(G\) 交於 \(D,E\)，且 \(E\) 在 \(x\) 軸上方。若 \([CDE]=24\)，求經過 \(C,D,E\) 的圓面積，以 \(\pi\) 表示。（8 分）
questions.hint: Angle bisector. Similar triangles. Right angle circumcircle radius = half hypotenuse.
questions.hintZh: 角平分線。相似三角形。直角外接圓半徑 = 斜邊一半。
questions.solution:
(a) G is the bisector 3x+4y-57=0.
(b) C=(19,0), M=(3,12), area AMC=150. Similar right triangles give CD/CA=2/5, hence CD=10. As angle CED is right, the circumcircle has radius 5 and area 25pi.

questions.stem:
14. Denote the origin by \(O\). \(A\) and \(B\) are points lying on two straight lines \(y=mx\) and \(y=-mx\) respectively. It is given that \(AB\) is a vertical line segment on the right side of the \(y\)-axis and its length is \(2k\), where \(m\) and \(k\) are positive constants.
(a) Express the area of \(\triangle OAB\) in terms of \(m\) and \(k\). (4 marks)
(b) Suppose the length of \(AB\) is 6 units and the area of \(\triangle OAB\) is 36 square units. Let \(P\) be a moving point on the same rectangular coordinate plane such that the area of \(\triangle PAB\) is always equal to that of \(\triangle OAB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(AB\). (1 mark)
(ii) Find the equation(s) of \(\Gamma\). (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 原點為 \(O\)。\(A,B\) 分別在 \(y=mx\)、\(y=-mx\) 上，線段 \(AB\) 垂直且在 \(y\) 軸右方，長為 \(2k\)，其中 \(m,k>0\)。
(a) 以 \(m,k\) 表示 \([OAB]\)。（4 分）
(b) 已知 \(AB=6\)、\([OAB]=36\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \([PAB]=[OAB]\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求所有軌跡方程。（4 分）
questions.hint: Intercept triangle area. Fixed height → parallel lines.
questions.hintZh: 截距三角形。固定高 → 平行線。
questions.solution:
(a) The endpoints are (k/m,±k); area=k^2/m.
(b) k=3,m=1/4, baseline x=12. Fixed height 12 gives the parallel branches x=0 and x=24.

questions.stem:
14. In a rectangular coordinate plane, \(OABC\) is a kite where \(A\) lies on the negative \(x\)-axis, \(O\) is the origin and \(OA\perp AB\). It is given that \(C\) lies in quadrant IV. A moving point \(P\) is equidistant from \(O\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that the area of \(\triangle OAB\) is \(8\) square units.
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) Someone claims that the area of \(OABC\) can be \(12\) square units. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(OABC\) 為直角坐標平面上的風箏形。\(O\) 為原點，\(A\) 在負 \(x\) 軸上，\(OA\perp AB\)，\(C\) 在第四象限。動點 \(P\) 與 \(O,B\) 等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)，且 \([OAB]=8\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(b) 有人聲稱 \([OABC]\) 可以等於 \(12\)。你是否同意？解釋。（7 分）
questions.hint: Kite area. Check if 12 is possible.
questions.hintZh: 箏形面積。檢查 12 可唔可能。
questions.solution:
The typed source does not specify which adjacent sides are equal. Under the source solution's pairing OA=AB and OC=BC:
(a) A=(-a,0), B=(-a,-a); area a^2/2=8 gives a=4 and Gamma:x+y+4=0.
(b) C=(t,-t-4), t>0, gives area OABC=16+4t>16, so 12 is impossible.
The equal-side pairing must be confirmed from the source; it is not implied by the word kite alone.

questions.stem:
A circle has centre \(O\) and radius \(5\) cm.
(a) Sketch the locus of the midpoints of all chords of length \(8\) cm.
(b) State another condition giving the same locus.
questions.stemZh:
一個圓的圓心為 \(O\)，半徑為 \(5\) cm。
(a) 畫出所有長 \(8\) cm 的弦的中點軌跡。
(b) 寫出另一個產生相同軌跡的條件。
questions.hint: Chord midpoint: OM² + half-chord² = r².
questions.hintZh: 弦中點：OM² + 半弦² = r²。
questions.solution:
(a) Let \(M\) be a chord midpoint. The perpendicular from \(O\) bisects the chord, so \(OM=\sqrt{5^2-4^2}=3\) cm. The locus is the complete circle with centre \(O\) and radius \(3\) cm.
(b) A moving point remains \(3\) cm from \(O\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \(OM=√(25−16)=3\)。軌跡是以 O 為圓心、半徑 3 的圓。

(b) 到 O 恆 3 cm。

questions.stem:
\(L:4x+3y-12=0\) meets the axes at \(A,B\). \(C=(c,0)\) and \([ABC]=2[OAB]\), where \(O\) is the origin.
(a) Find \(c\).
(b) Take the greater value of \(c\). \(P\) lies on the right-hand side of \(L\) and \([PAB]=[ABC]\). (i) Describe its locus relative to \(L\). (ii) Find its equation.
questions.stemZh:
\(L:4x+3y-12=0\) 與兩坐標軸交於 \(A,B\)。\(C=(c,0)\)，且 \([ABC]=2[OAB]\)，\(O\) 為原點。

(b) 取較大的 \(c\)。\(P\) 位於 \(L\) 右側，且 \([PAB]=[ABC]\)。(i) 描述軌跡與 \(L\) 的關係。(ii) 求其方程。
questions.hint: Intercepts. Area condition. Choose correct branch.
questions.hintZh: 截距。面積條件。選正確分支。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(3,0),B=(0,4)\) and \([OAB]=6\). Thus \(2|c-3|=12\), giving \(c=-3,9\).
(b)(i) The parallel through \(C=(9,0)\) on the right-hand side.
(ii) The distance from \(C\) to \(L\) is \(24/5\), so the required branch is \(4x+3y-12=24\), or \(4x+3y-36=0\).

14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((11,20)\) and \((-13,2)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a)
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) The circle \(C\) passes through the points \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that \(G\) lies on the straight line
\[
x-18y+49=0.
\](i) Find the equation of \(C\).
(ii) \(DE\) is a chord of the circle \(C\) such that \(AB=DE\) and \(AB\parallel DE\). Find the perimeter of the quadrilateral \(ABED\).
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A=(11,20)\)、\(B=(-13,2)\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩點等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求軌跡方程。
(b) 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A,B\)，圓心 \(G\) 在 \(x-18y+49=0\) 上。
(i) 求圓方程；(ii) \(DE\) 是另一條弦，\(DE=AB\) 且 \(DE\parallel AB\)。求四邊形 \(ABED\) 周界。（8 分）
questions.hint: Perpendicular bisector. Parallel chords form rectangle.
questions.hintZh: 垂直平分線。平行弦成矩形。
questions.solution:
(a) The perpendicular bisector is 4x+3y-29=0.
(b)(i) The centre is (5,3), squared radius 325.
(ii) The distinct equal parallel chord is the reflected chord. Chord length 30 and separation 20 form a rectangle, giving perimeter 100, with endpoints labelled in simple-polygon order.

\[
L:y=-5.
\]Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(C\).
(a) Show that the equation of \(C\) is
\[
y=\frac{1}{4}x^2+x-3.
\](b) Let \(A\) and \(B\) be the points of intersection of \(C\) and the \(x\)-axis, where \(A\) lies to the right of \(B\).
(i) Find the coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\).
(ii) Let \(M\) be a point on \(L\) and \(N\) be the point of intersection of \(AM\) and \(C\). If
\[
\text{area of }\triangle BMN:\text{area of }\triangle BAN=2:3,

questions.hint: Equate distances → parabola. x-intercepts. Collinearity ratio.
questions.hintZh: 等距 → 拋物線。x 截距。共線比例。
questions.solution:

(b)(i) A=(2,0),B=(-6,0).
(ii) Collinearity gives |yN+5|/|yN|=2/3. The branches yN=-3 and -15 arise; -15 is below the parabola's minimum -4. At y=-3, x=0 or -4. Both points qualify.

questions.stem:
\(A=(0,2)\) and \(B=(-2,0)\). \(P=(x,y)\) satisfies \(AP^2+BP^2=2PN^2\), where \(N\) is the perpendicular foot on the \(x\)-axis.
(a) Find the locus of \(P\).
(b) \(Q\) satisfies \(AQ=BQ\). (i) Find its locus. (ii) Susan claims the two loci intersect at two points. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(0,2)\)、\(B=(-2,0)\)。\(P=(x,y)\) 滿足 \(AP^2+BP^2=2PN^2\)，其中 \(N\) 是 \(P\) 到 \(x\) 軸的垂足。
(a) 求 \(P\) 的軌跡方程。
(b) \(Q\) 滿足 \(AQ=BQ\)。(i) 求其軌跡方程。(ii) Susan 聲稱兩軌跡交於兩點。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.hint: Distance squared sum. Substitute for intersection.
questions.hintZh: 距離平方和。代入交點。
questions.solution:
(a) \(PN^2=y^2\). Thus \(x^2+(y-2)^2+(x+2)^2+y^2=2y^2\), giving \(y=x^2/2+x+2\).
(b)(i) \(x^2+(y-2)^2=(x+2)^2+y^2\) gives \(x+y=0\).
(ii) Disagree. Substituting \(y=-x\) gives \((x+2)^2=0\): exactly one intersection, \((-2,2)\).

questions.stem:
\(C:x^2+y^2-8x-ky-88=0\), where \(k>0\), has radius \(15\) and centre \(X\).
(a) Find \(X\).
(b) \(L:3x-4y+92=0\) meets \(C\) at distinct \(A,B\). \(P\) on \(L\) is nearest to \(X\). Find \(PX\).
(c) \(Q\) on \(C\) is nearest to \(P\). (i) Describe the relationship among \(P,Q,X\). (ii) Find \([AXBQ]\).
questions.hint: Find X. Distance. Tangent length. Rhombus area.
questions.hintZh: 找 X。距離。切線長。菱形面積。
questions.solution:
(a) \(16+k^2/4+88=225\) gives \(k=22\), so \(X=(4,11)\).
(b) \(PX=|3(4)-4(11)+92|/5=12\).
(c)(i) They are collinear with \(P\) between \(X,Q\).
(ii) \(AP=BP=\sqrt{15^2-12^2}=9\), hence \(AB=18\). The perpendicular diagonals \(AB,XQ\) have lengths \(18,15\), so \([AXBQ]=18(15)/2=135\).

questions.stem:
The coordinates of \(P\), \(Q\), \(R\) and \(M\) are \((0,2)\), \((4,0)\), \((9,5)\) and \((5,8)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(P\), \(Q\) and \(R\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) Prove that \(M\) lies inside \(C\).
(c) Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). Let \(N\) be the point on \(C\) nearest to \(M\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship among \(G\), \(M\) and \(N\).
(ii) Find the equation of the straight line through \(M\) and \(N\).
questions.hint: General circle through 3 points. Solve D,E,F.
questions.hintZh: 三點定圓一般式。解 D,E,F。
questions.solution:
(a) Write \(x^2+y^2+Dx+Ey+F=0\). Substitution of the three points gives \(D=-8,E=-10,F=16\). Thus \((x-4)^2+(y-5)^2=25\).
(b) \(GM^2=1^2+3^2=10<25\).
(c)(i) They are collinear, with \(M\) between \(G,N\).
(ii) The line through \(G=(4,5),M=(5,8)\) is \(3x-y-7=0\).

questions.stem:
The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,6)\) and \((8,0)\) respectively.
(a) \(P\) is a moving point such that \(PA=PB\). Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma_1\) of \(P\).
(b) \(Q\) is a moving point such that \(AQ\perp QB\). Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma_2\) of \(Q\).
(c) \(\Gamma_1\) and \(\Gamma_2\) intersect at points \(M\) and \(N\). Find \(MN\).
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(0,6),B=(8,0)\)。
(a) \(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)。求軌跡 \(\Gamma_1\)。
(b) \(Q\) 滿足 \(AQ\perp QB\)。求軌跡 \(\Gamma_2\)。
(c) 兩軌跡交於 \(M,N\)。求 \(MN\)。
questions.hint: Perpendicular bisector. Diameter circle. Bisector through centre → diameter chord.
questions.hintZh: 垂直平分線。直徑圓。平分線過中心 → 直徑弦。
questions.solution:
(a) \(\Gamma_1:4x-3y-7=0\).
(b) \(\Gamma_2:(x-4)^2+(y-3)^2=25\), excluding \(A,B\).
(c) The perpendicular bisector passes through the diameter midpoint \((4,3)\), so \(MN\) is a diameter: \(MN=10\).
